dependency_graph: The actual carrier is closed, closed under addition/nonnegative scaling, generating, and has strictly positive mass off zero.
An explicit positive decomposition proves generation; the ProbabilityCone instance uses these derived properties.
Every positive decomposition z=u-v has cost u0+v0 at least both |z0| and norm(spatial z).
For M=max(|t|,norm w)>0, q=w/M and a=(M+t)/2,b=(M-t)/2 construct u=(a,aq),v=(b,-bq) with u-v=z and cost M. M=0 is separately proved to imply z=0.
The existing ProbabilityCone.value is the actual sInf of positive-decomposition costs. Its two universal inequalities yield value_eq.
Complex.norm_eq_sqrt_sq_add_sq proves the literal sqrt coordinate expression; carrier and mass equalities identify the instance with RotationModel.
The actual model branches form instruments for that ProbabilityCone by the already proved model cone invariance and per-action mass conservation.
claims.boundary_checks: The zero vector and M=0 branch are handled separately. The formula holds for every signed state, not just normalized cone states or mass-zero differences. State aliases are definitionally the same Fin3 real functions; mass equality is literal proj0.
claims.remaining_gap: None in the base-norm dictionary. This module alone does not prove the regular-polygon approximation, its finite lift, or its observation-law TV error bound.
